<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong M peak, an M+1 peak at ~16.5 % (consistent with ~15 carbons), and an M+2 peak at ~4.6 % (consistent with a single sulfur atom’s 34S isotope) and no significant M+2 ~33 % or ~100 % peaks that would indicate chlorine or bromine—we can definitively identify carbon and sulfur in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
